rows.definition: The ctxplan threshold struct deciding when a provenance-tagged context assumption (stated vs inferred confidence) is promoted into an accepted working assumption.
rows.distinction: An effect-context assumption-threshold table; it neither authorizes tools nor loads a policy manifest, and its conservative default is the separate DefaultAssumptionPolicy constructor.

rows.definition: The header-only planner that reads bounded safetensors headers and emits the SafetensorsPreflight tensor census plus loader-role classification before any weight allocation.
rows.distinction: It builds the plan; it is not the plan's input struct (SafetensorsPreflightInput), the per-tensor census row (SafetensorsPreflightTensor), or the GGUF-side ManifestPreflight.

rows.definition: The macbench MTP-comparison quality gate: the pinned policy identity (ID, version, SHA256) and minimum score a speculative-decoding trial must beat to count as qualified.
rows.distinction: A benchmark qualification gate, not an authorization/capability Policy manifest; its serialized wire key is the separate quality_policy label and its statistical sibling is MultiplicityPolicy.

rows.definition: The ops-run receipt field (config_policy) carrying the harness config-policy evidence verdict: source, digest, status, and refusal reason for the child-enforcement check.
rows.distinction: Evidence about the harness CONFIG policy attached to an ops-run receipt; it is not the inference-preflight receipt next to it, nor the on-disk policy manifest it digests.

rows.definition: The model ExecutionPolicy iota value marking a session whose execution may roam across host/device layers (portable), as opposed to being pinned to the accelerator.
rows.distinction: A value of the execution-policy enum, not the DeviceOnly twin, not the SetExecutionPolicy mutator, and not the V4.1 session's v41DeviceOnlyPolicy predicate.

rows.definition: The cmd-layer helper that stamps a failed inference-preflight receipt onto the ops-run receipt and reports the typed refusal before any harness launch.
rows.distinction: The failure path around the InferencePreflight receipt; it neither performs the gateway probe nor records capability evidence (opsRunAddCapabilityEvidence).

rows.definition: The environment variable selecting the agent/chat adjudication posture (default_open | fail_closed | admit_and_log) when the --posture flag is absent.
rows.distinction: An env knob choosing among the existing posture values; it defines no new posture and is distinct from the guard plane's reasoning-posture knobs.

rows.definition: The typed gateway-probe qualification receipt (inference_preflight) on the ops-run receipt: status, receipt ref, and reason proving the target gateway answers before a harness launches.
rows.distinction: The probe result itself, not the ConfigPolicy evidence beside it, not the failOpsRunInferencePreflight failure stamp, and not the general preflight ladder.

rows.definition: The radixkv stats field reporting which eviction policy performed the most recent eviction, so operators can see the live policy choice without tracing calls.
rows.distinction: A read-only observation of the last eviction decision; it selects nothing, unlike KVEvictPolicy (the compute-side KV eviction policy type) or the preemption-policy mutators.

rows.definition: The MCP client-dialect spelling of the fak_adjudicate tool (server `fak`, OpenCode double fak_fak_ prefix) that NormalizeToolName decodes back to the canonical tool name.
rows.distinction: A wire spelling of one existing tool, not a second adjudicator: the handler is handleFakAdjudicate and the concept is the single adjudicator kernel.

rows.definition: The constructor name shared by internal/policy.NewPolicy (compiles manifest bytes into a loaded *Policy at generation 1) and l3server/eviction.NewPolicy (builds a named eviction Policy).
rows.distinction: Two package-local factories behind one name: neither is the loaded Policy value they produce, the ToPolicy manifest conversion, nor the unrelated view/mem/set policies.

rows.definition: The cmd-layer helper appending capability-evidence refs (config-policy digest, inference-preflight receipt ref) to the ops-run launch-identity receipt.
rows.distinction: Evidence bookkeeping on the launch identity; it grants no capability and performs no preflight itself.

rows.definition: The end-to-end metadata-boundary entrypoint that parses a serialized request and adjudicates it against declared capabilities, returning a typed result instead of guessing.
rows.distinction: One package-local boundary function in bitnetmeta (raw, caps) and vllmquant (raw); it is the parse-then-adjudicate seam, not the gateway's proposed-call adjudication or the FP4 metadata adjudicator.

rows.definition: The stable identifier field of a verification/quality policy document (vulkan score-proof structure ID, macbench quality-policy ID) that pins WHICH policy a result was judged under.
rows.distinction: Names the policy; it does not pin its bytes (PolicySHA256) and is not the attestation-plane policyRef digest.

rows.definition: The human-readable placement-policy label (TEMPORAL_PINNED, STREAMING_BYPASS, PARTITIONED, ...) on strix tiling/streaming and quant-forward descriptors.
rows.distinction: A display label for a memory-placement choice; it carries no authorization weight and is not the policy manifest's identity (PolicyID) or a PolicyKnob.

rows.definition: The content-digest field pinning the exact bytes of a quality/verification policy document so a comparison arm can prove it ran under the same policy text.
rows.distinction: Pins policy BYTES; it complements PolicyID (which policy) and differs from the guard-spawn PolicyDigest provenance and the generic policyRef attestation digest.

rows.definition: The past-participle term used in comments, docs, and error strings for an executable or tool whose hash or availability was verified before launch (the completed preflight).
rows.distinction: A state adjective about a finished check; it is not the preflight ladder mechanism, a PreflightVerdict value, or the plural preflights collection.

rows.definition: The JSON wire key (quality_policy) carrying the ComparisonQualityPolicy block inside a macbench packet/arm, mirrored by the arm's policy_id/policy_sha256 fields.
rows.distinction: A serialization label, not the gate itself: the concept is ComparisonQualityPolicy; this token is how it travels on the wire.

rows.definition: The Qwen3.8 MTP downgrade reason emitted when operator policy disables multi-token-prediction speculation, distinguishing a policy refusal from memory-unsafe or correctness-diverged downgrades.
rows.distinction: A policy-originated MTP refusal reason; it is not the hardware fallback policy (FallbackPolicy) nor a device-residency execution policy.

rows.definition: The WSL command-availability probe executor behind fak validate: runs a candidate capability command under the preflighted timeout/retry bounds and returns its output.
rows.distinction: Executes one probe command; it does not judge the verdict (validateWSLCapabilityVerdict) and is not the CI preflight runner.

rows.definition: The input struct (checkpoint directory + optional HF config override) feeding BuildSafetensorsPreflight's header-only plan.
rows.distinction: The plan's INPUT, not the builder (BuildSafetensorsPreflight) nor the per-tensor census row (SafetensorsPreflightTensor).

rows.definition: The gateway admission cap bundle (ratelimit.TokenCaps: total/input/output/uncached ceilings, concurrency, target utilization) that seeds a token rate gate.
rows.distinction: Per-request TOKEN admission caps; it is not the batch-policy scheduling knob, the principal-rate book, or the fleet admission policy.

rows.definition: The gateway helper concatenating pre-recovery refusals with the live adjudications of a turn so denial-recovery replays keep every verdict in order.
rows.distinction: A slice-join over ToolAdjudication rows; it produces no verdict itself and is not the FakExt.Adjudications wire counter.

rows.definition: The V4.1 session predicate true when the session runs device-only, gating compressed-publication, engram-gate, and gather-op paths off the host fallback.
rows.distinction: A V4.1 session-mode predicate; it is not the generic ExecutionPolicyDeviceOnly enum value nor the portable twin ExecutionPolicyPortable.
